atomicity.reason: Expresses exactly one obligation: no mandatory migration of a component's build definition to Bazel.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained given 'harmonized build' as an established project term (used identically in the parent story and elsewhere in this requirement set).

feasibility.reason: Feasible: a policy/process constraint on the harmonized build's admission criteria, not a technically demanding property.

parent_fit.reason: Near-verbatim operationalization of the parent story's central ask: contributors are not forced to migrate to Bazel to keep using their own tooling.

unambiguity.reason: Single reading; the prohibition (no required migration) and its scope (per-component, to remain part of the harmonized build) are both stated plainly.

verifiability.reason: Testable: leave a component's native build definition un-migrated and confirm it still remains part of the harmonized build (e.g. still builds/is tracked in the overall build).

summary: Crisp, unambiguous, atomic restatement of the parent's central no-forced-migration obligation; passes cleanly on all axes.
